title: SUE Pure + BRK Overlay — Consensus 최강 단일 시그널 + 검증 overlay

design.concept: L-415: SUE = 3rd independent alpha. STR_943(EPS_chg)보다 SUE 순수 시그널이 학술적으로 더 강건. SUE 단일 + STR_1060 검증 overlay.
design.sue_definition: SUE = (EPS_actual - EPS_forecast) / std(forecast_error), trailing consensus data

overlay.dd_brake: DD_med only (start 4%, t-1 lag, no short DD)
